name: Comprehensive Power Ranking
author: KentJ
description: Adds a standalone comprehensive national power ranking for WorldBox, scoring each civilization across six dimensions (military, economy, population, territory, city development, national influence) with a weighted geometric mean.
description_cn: 为 WorldBox 新增综合国力排行榜，用加权几何平均综合评估每个文明国家的军事、经济、人口、领土、城市发展、国家影响力。

compatibility.note: Built against the public WorldBox game API; no game files are modified.
